x: Ten claret & gold vests in the first twenty four finishers! And Bill Curtin (still 2 yrs away from being a youth) finishing second, nine seconds ahead of the winner at Walton, R.

Bill Curtin scored an excellent win in beating Martin of Walton in exactly the same time as last year's winner (Hayes of Mitcham). Showing great form, he improved by 40 seconds on his sixth place of last year and led our team to a useful third place - the same as 12 months ago.
